settings.label: Logo image
settings.info: Recommended: SVG or PNG, max 200px wide. Uploading here overrides the built-in wordmark.

settings.label: Social sharing image
settings.info: Used for OG/Twitter card previews. Recommended: 1200×630 px.

settings.label: Default meta description
settings.default: Picked delivers one hand-selected specialty coffee from one featured independent roaster to your letterbox every month. Join the waitlist.
settings.info: Used when a page has no specific description. Max 160 characters.

settings.label: Klaviyo public key
settings.info: Your 6-character public company ID from Klaviyo → Account → Settings → API Keys. Safe to expose client-side.

settings.label: Waitlist list ID
settings.info: The ID of your 'Picked Waitlist' list in Klaviyo (e.g. XxXxXx). Found in Audience → Lists & Segments → your list → Settings.

settings.label: GA4 Measurement ID (optional)
settings.info: If provided, GA4 will be activated after cookie consent. Format: G-XXXXXXXXXX. Leave blank to disable GA4.

settings.label: Show cookie consent banner
settings.info: Required for UK/GDPR compliance. Disabling this will still honour Shopify's Customer Privacy API.

settings.content: Leave all off during Phase 0 (waitlist). Flip on at Phase 1 launch.

settings.label: Enable refer-to-climb-the-queue mechanic
settings.info: Controls the visibility of the referral tease section on the landing page.
